label: Cluster assessment of the thought, life and nobility leaves of the cogito route to the grades
summary: Issue #1751 bottom-out walk of the GOD_4 prima via route, lane C (thought, life and nobility), drafted on main df4909cb025d2e53fee6071a32defe9cf2721284. The nine leaves end the cheapest expansion of argument bfaf6f92 (gradesFromCogito), the only verified support of the quarta via grades premise a9622441, which the prima via reaches through c27dce66 and 697b7dc4. At baseline all nine were currentness 'none' (GOD_4 root 423 open: 84 current, 158 legacy-only, 181 none). Read: the Lean bodies in Round3CogitoBase, Round2ExistenceAct, MotionMapsBatch1 and the quarta via vocabulary; definitions c075da22, c0cbef1c, 1c062aa6, a07c30f9, ce8ccc1a, b89f3234, b7c083b2, 5766de66, b412016a, aad0156a; disambiguations 80b5fc49, 1f2d3b9b, 9880c06b and the three thought-episode senses; the seven supports relations with gap notes on the leaves; claim 611be1f0 (q.18 a.3); the legacy rival file for a9622441; the accepted 2026-11-17 assessment of e81971f1 and 30e6e01c in attempt e64d5241; the proofs of quartaVia and oneFirstMoverViaMaximeEns. Ran the semantics preflight on bfaf6f92, every leaf and the candidate bundle: single senses, no unbridged mixing. Findings: (1) every argument reaching GOD_4 that takes a9622441 directly passes it to quartaVia or maximeEnsCausesBeingOfAll, whose proofs use only the verum conjunct (697b7dc4, f8992ef7, 87dd8489, beec1dc1, 661ce61d, fd1f7e75, 0a639ec4, 117cc323, df653f4e, e2a7ffb3); only the degree-fork and unbounded-core analyses use bonum; (2) NOBLE has no definition record, GOOD is not linked from a9622441 or e4a7ef4b, and IsOperation has no episode-level definition; (3) LIVING has a precision gap: the gloss of b89f3234 lacks the qualifier 'as to the principle of the operation'; its examples and f91f5056 select the middle reading, on which both 0ce7b6c5 and e7cbb87f hold, and no record or source adopts the strict reading (claim 611be1f0 grades life); (4) the universals of 1c8383f5, e4a7ef4b and 17667565 exceed what the route uses; (5) the verum half of e4a7ef4b reduces to a nobility-as-being bridge plus the sourced comparative truth-being statement 5a948c37; (6) no inconsistent package found among the nine; (7) bfaf6f92 is not a transcription. End states: defended primitive or meaning postulate 95c5138f, 1722a80f, d4ea5ebf, e7cbb87f; defended direct option c2fa06f2, 0ce7b6c5; open with a named blocker 17667565, 1c8383f5, e4a7ef4b. The note section holds the table, the objection classification and the overall judgment.
blocker: Open: no definition of NOBLE (degree of being or evaluative standing) and no linked GOOD sense for 1c8383f5 and e4a7ef4b; no comparative goodness-being bridge for the bonum half of e4a7ef4b; no warrant on file for the universal of 1c8383f5 beyond the paradigm pair (lexical priority of self-operation or eminent containment); the gloss of b89f3234 lacks the qualifier 'as to the principle of the operation' that fixes the middle reading on which 0ce7b6c5 and e7cbb87f both hold; no episode-level definition of IsOperation, and the ThoughtOccurs export forgets the realizing episode, so a doubt-restricted sibling of 17667565 cannot yet be applied. Next test: derive e462cf2f from the thinker inputs, 0ce7b6c5, e7cbb87f and the esse sibling of 1c8383f5, then the verum conjunct with 5a948c37; the warrant of the esse sibling decides the outcome.

current_assessment.scope: Lane C of the #1751 bottom-out walk: the nine open leaves of the cheapest expansion of bfaf6f92 (gradesFromCogito) to the grades premise a9622441. Cogito inputs 95c5138f and 1722a80f (for e81971f1 via 7d7b89e7), agency inputs 17667565, d4ea5ebf and c2fa06f2 (for 30e6e01c via 4fc44748), life inputs 0ce7b6c5 and e7cbb87f, nobility inputs 1c8383f5 and e4a7ef4b. The 2026-11-17 assessment of e81971f1 and 30e6e01c in e64d5241 keeps its own scope and is reused unchanged.
current_assessment.assessment: Under the fixed meanings (performed doubt c075da22; thought as broad cogitatio, THOUGHT_EPISODE_VERSUS_OPINING_1; bearer only, ce8ccc1a; living as operating from oneself, b89f3234; TRUE_3 for verum) the cogito half is well warranted where used. 95c5138f is a performative first-person datum: its denial is not strictly self-refuting (asserting that no one performs such a doubting is not itself such a doubting; control NoPerformedDoubt shows only that the denial is consistent), not epistemically self-undermining, and not an inquiry precondition; that standing plausibly belongs to e81971f1 (analyst observation; e64d5241 assesses its performed-episode warrant, not this standing). It is dispensable for e81971f1 through f93f2dfd. 1722a80f and d4ea5ebf are meaning postulates of the selected senses, the first conditional on c075da22 excluding non-cognitive production, the second on an episode-level definition of IsOperation. c2fa06f2 is a defended direct option for immanent thought episodes. 17667565 is open: strong on the Thomist immanent-activity reading, failing as a universal on a voluntary-doing reading; the route needs only the active doubting episode. The life half is strong on the middle sense (having within oneself the principle of an immanent operation), which the definition's examples and f91f5056 already select; the gloss of b89f3234 needs one qualifier ('as to the principle of the operation'). No record or source adopts the strict reading (moved by another in no respect); claim 611be1f0 grades life and supports the middle reading. A loose reading (any own active power) would make e7cbb87f false and is excluded by the definition's counterexample. 0ce7b6c5 is a defended direct option and e7cbb87f an observation datum on the middle sense; c2fa06f2 alone does not yield 0ce7b6c5 (wrong direction, agent to bearer). The nobility half carries all the evaluative content of a9622441: 1c8383f5 has strong prima facie support for the paradigm pair and none on file for its universal; e4a7ef4b is open, with its verum half reducible to a nobility-as-being bridge and 5a948c37, and its bonum half lacking a comparative bridge; NOBLE is undefined. Value anti-realism is kept against the evaluative reading only (independent justification: queerness and the explanatory idleness of value comparatives, attribution deferred); unlike the legacy rival file, it is not counted against grades of ontological truth. For a9622441 the route is one support option beside its stating claim c558e6bc, which states the conclusion and is not counted as support: it adds independent warrant for the existence of a pair differing in life (a living bearer of an occurring thought, of which the Lean type does not assert Actual, and an actual non-living thing), relocates rather than supports the evaluative content, and would add partial independent warrant for the verum conjunct, the only conjunct the prima via consumer uses, once the esse sibling of 1c8383f5 is registered (or NOBLE is fixed as degree of being). Overall: moderate support for the verum conjunct, conditional on the unregistered esse sibling of 1c8383f5 (or a definition of nobility as degree of being); at present the verum conjunct rests on 1c8383f5 and e4a7ef4b. No independent gain for the bonum and nobile conjuncts. A provisional warrant judgment, separate from proof validity and computed closure.
current_assessment.next_test: Derive e462cf2f (something is more a being than something) from the thinker inputs, 0ce7b6c5, e7cbb87f and the esse sibling of 1c8383f5 (whatever lives is more in being than any actual thing that does not live); then the existence of a pair with MoreIn verum from the right-to-left direction of the second conjunct of 5a948c37. The verum-only sibling of quartaVia follows immediately, since its proof uses only hVerum. The live question is the warrant of the esse sibling, which says living things are more in being, against rivals that deny degrees of being; that question, not the formal step, decides the outcome. Second: an episode-level definition of IsOperation and a doubt-restricted sibling of 17667565 with an adapter that keeps the realizing episode through the ThoughtOccurs export.
